## Change classification

- [ ] Minor correction
- [ ] Major/application change
- [ ] Database-affecting change
- [ ] Governance/documentation only

## Promotion and evidence

- Source branch:
- Target release line:
- Exact candidate commit:
- Vercel preview URL:
- Test evidence:
- Preview evidence:
- Rollback commit or procedure:

## Safety declarations

- [ ] The complete diff has been reviewed.
- [ ] Automated tests, type checking, and build pass.
- [ ] Secrets and private data are absent from the diff and logs.
- [ ] Production is unchanged by this pull request.
- [ ] Any database change has an immutable migration, checksum, backup evidence, restore rehearsal, and separate approval.
- [ ] Promotion will use an exact commit; no direct server edit or unreviewed branch deployment is planned.
